description:
Tens of thousands gather in Belgrade, Serbia for the ‘Students Win’ rally ahead of Sunday’s parliamentary election. The party was formed during anti-corruption protests in 2024, and now poses a major challenge to the ruling party of former President Aleksandar Vucic.

description:
Several surveillance videos show the moment a 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck China's southwestern region of Tibet, killing at least 16 people. The ​quake is the strongest to hit China since January 2024.
